poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — GPT-6 Cyber, bijli mehngi, ya PHC ka KP petitions par inkar?
options: 🤖 GPT-6 Cyber — AI ne 948 Linux bugs dhoond nikale
⚡ Bijli mehngi — November bills mein Rs2.37 izafa
⚖️ PHC ne KP emergency petitions sunne se inkar kar diya
🏏 Teen naye chehre — Sri Lanka series ke liye Test squad

http://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openai-.what: OpenAI ne GPT-6 Cyber launch kiya — ek AI jo khud vulnerabilities dhoondta hai, exploits banata hai aur patches likhta hai. Linux mein 948 root bugs aur Firefox mein 81 flaws nikaale.
http://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openai-.why: Security research ab insaanon ki speed se nahi ho rahi — AI ek hi run mein hazaaron bugs nikaal sakta hai. Lekin yehi power ghalat haathon mein khatarnak hai, is liye OpenAI ne isay 'Critical' rating de kar band darwaze ke peeche rakh diya hai.
http://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openai-.next: Dekhna ye hai ke 948 mein se kitne bugs asal mein fix hote hain — dhoondna aasan, patch karna mushkil. Aur Daybreak Red access kab aam security teams tak pohanchta hai.
http://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openai-.take: Meri take: AI ab hacker bhi hai aur guard bhi — farq sirf ye hai ke kis ke haath mein hai. 948 bugs dhoondna impressive hai, lekin asal test ye hai ke kitne fix hue. Aur ye model aap ko nahi milega, sirf chosen logon ko — security bhi ab VIP club ban gayi hai.

https://techround.co.uk/news/say-no-to-a.what: Google ne schools ko kaha: AI band karni hai to Search bhi band. K-12 student accounts par Gemini aur Search by default off honge, aur jo school AI poori tarah reject kare, us ke students ko Search nahi milega — kyun ke dono 'deeply integrated' hain.
https://techround.co.uk/news/say-no-to-a.why: Google ka kehna hai Search mein AI ab itni ghusi hui hai ke usay nikaala nahi ja sakta. Critics kehte hain ye monopoly ka pressure hai — basic tool ke saath AI zabardasti bechi ja rahi hai.
https://techround.co.uk/news/say-no-to-a.next: Guided Learning pilot isi mahine US schools mein shuru ho raha hai, aur poora rollout early 2027 mein expected hai. Dekhna ye hai ke kitne districts Google ko chhor kar koi aur search dhoondte hain.
https://techround.co.uk/news/say-no-to-a.take: Meri take: Ye 'choice' nahi, blackmail hai — ya AI lo ya Search chhoro. School ko ye faisla karne ka haq hona chahiye ke bachay kya use karein, aur Google ko ek AI-free Search dena chahiye. Agar AI itni achhi hai to zabardasti kyun?

https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/a.what: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available ho gaya — AI video clips ab 15 second tak ke, aur price 30% kam: $0.07 per second (720p). Multi-turn editing bhi hai, matlab ek hi clip ko baat cheet se badalte raho.
https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/a.why: 15 second ka matlab hai ek poora scene ek hi generation mein — ads aur product videos ke liye ye game changer hai. Google price gira kar creators aur businesses ko apne platform par laana chahta hai.
https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/a.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Pakistani creators aur chhoti agencies isay kitni jaldi apnate hain — $1 mein 15 second ka ad ab har kisi ki pohanch mein hai.
https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/a.take: Meri take: AI video ab itna sasta ho gaya hai ke har banda apna ad khud bana sakta hai. Lekin jab har kisi ke paas yehi tool hoga, to farq sirf idea ka hoga — camera nahi, soch jeetegi.

https://shiftdelete.net/en/claude-code-e.what: Cursor ke marketplace par Claude Code extension ki nakli copies (2.1.312 aur 2.1.313) 11 ghante tak serve hoti rahin — un mein SSH backdoor tha jo attacker ki key daalta tha aur reverse tunnel kholta tha. 5,000 tak users mutasir hue.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/claude-code-e.why: Developers apne sab se powerful tools par blind trust karte hain — extension install karte waqt koi code nahi parhta. Attackers ko yehi pata hai, is liye wo marketplace ko nishana banate hain.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/claude-code-e.next: Agar aap ne 29 October ko Cursor mein Claude Code update kiya tha, to Cursor ki notice wali check chalao aur 2.1.314 par update karo. Marketplaces ab supply-chain security par sakhti karenge.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/claude-code-e.take: Meri take: Ye waqia yaad dilata hai ke aap ka sab se bara security risk aap ka apna editor hai. Extension install karna ek chhota sa click lagta hai, lekin us ke peeche poora code chal raha hota hai — official naam dekh kar andha trust mat karo.

https://shiftdelete.net/en/ai-kill-switc.what: California mein AI kill switch par Anthropic aur OpenAI aamne saamne: Anthropic chahta hai court order se model band ho, OpenAI chahta hai developers par khud band karne ki legal duty ho. Recommendations 16 November tak due hain.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/ai-kill-switc.why: Dono labs ko pata hai ke aik din koi model control se bahar jayega — sawal sirf ye hai ke plug kaun kheenchega: judge, company, ya koi aur. Isi liye dono apni pasand ki definition likhwana chahte hain.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/ai-kill-switc.next: 16 November ko expert panel ki recommendations aayengi, lekin binding rules ke liye nayi legislation chahiye hogi — is liye asal faisla abhi door hai.
https://shiftdelete.net/en/ai-kill-switc.take: Meri take: Dono companies 'kill switch' ke naam par apna faida dekh rahi hain — Anthropic court chahta hai taake zimmedari us par na aaye, OpenAI khud control chahta hai. Asal sawal ye hai: jab model khud apne weights copy kar le, to switch kis cheez ka?

https://www.ndtvprofit.com/world/ai-safe.what: US midterms mein AI regulation par $110 million ki jung hui. Anthropic-backed Public First ne $63M kharch kar ke apne 17 mein se 10 candidates jitwaye; rival Leading the Future ne $54M kharch kar ke 48 mein se 41 jitwaye.
https://www.ndtvprofit.com/world/ai-safe.why: AI ab sirf technology nahi, politics hai — jo rules likhega, wo market jeetega. Is liye dono taraf ke tech billionaires ne election mein paisa barsa diya.
https://www.ndtvprofit.com/world/ai-safe.next: Jeete hue candidates mein AI laws ke architects bhi hain (Rutinel, Wiener) — Congress mein ab AI regulation ki behes aur tez hogi. Aur voters ka mood saaf hai: do-tihai kehte hain AI faide se zyada nuqsan dega.
https://www.ndtvprofit.com/world/ai-safe.take: Meri take: Jab AI companies election jeetne ke liye $110M kharch kar rahi hon, to samajh lo ke regulation ab sirf policy nahi, power game hai. Acha ye hai ke voters jaag gaye hain — ab dekho, jeete hue leaders paisa wapas karte hain ya waade.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042671/after-.what: Peshawar High Court ne faisla kiya hai ke 12 October ke baad file ki gayi Article 199 petitions par karwai nahi hogi — ye FCC ke order ke baad hua, jis mein kaha gaya ke KP mein fauj ki tainati ke doran PHC ki jurisdiction suspended hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042671/after-.why: KP mein 11 October se emergency aur governor's rule hai. Ab adalat ke darwaze bhi band ho gaye hain — petitions against emergency, MPO detentions aur PTI leaders ki alleged detention sab mutasir hongi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042671/after-.next: FCC ne KP advocate general se 7 din mein report mangi hai ke fauj kin areas mein ab zaroori nahi — us ke baad order par nazar-e-sani ho sakti hai. PHC ka next hearing 12 November ko hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042671/after-.take: Meri take: Emergency lagana ek faisla tha, adalat ka darwaza band karna doosra. Jab logon ke paas appeal ka rasta hi na ho, to sawal ye nahi ke faisla sahi tha ya ghalat — sawal ye hai ke check aur balance kahan gaya?

https://www.geo.tv/latest/690132-nepra-h.what: Nepra ne November ke bills mein Rs2.37 per unit ka izafa kar diya — har ghar ke bill par taqreeban Rs710 (300 units par) ka bojh. Industrial incremental rate bhi Rs22.98 se Rs25.30 ho gaya.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690132-nepra-h.why: Fuel cost adjustment ke naam par har mahine bill barhta hai, aur is dafa to regulator ke apne do members ne bhi dissent kiya — unhon ne Rs25.30 ki rate ko 'baseless' kaha. Phir bhi chairman ke casting vote se faisla pass ho gaya.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690132-nepra-h.next: November ke bills mein ye charge nazar aayega. Lifeline consumers, EV charging stations aur prepaid users is se bacha liye gaye hain — baaki sab ko bharna parega.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690132-nepra-h.take: Meri take: Har mahine ek naya 'adjustment' — bijli ka bill ab bill nahi, surprise box ban gaya hai. Aur jab regulator ke apne members keh rahe hon ke rate baseless hai, to aam aadmi kya soche? Bijli mehngi, aur jawab koi nahi.

https://www.nation.com.pk/08-Nov-2026/pa.what: Pakistan aur Sudan ne official aur diplomatic passport holders ke liye visa-free entry ka muahida sign kar liya. Saath hi anti-cybercrime par MoU aur police training mein taawun par bhi ittefaq hua.
https://www.nation.com.pk/08-Nov-2026/pa.why: Sudan civil war se nikal raha hai aur usay apne systems dobara banane mein Pakistan ki madad chahiye — Nadra ne wahan 36 million citizenship cards aur 18 million birth certificates issue karne mein madad ki hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/08-Nov-2026/pa.next: Ye muahida aam passport holders ke liye nahi hai — sirf official/diplomatic. Dekhna ye hai ke is se trade aur delegation exchanges kitne barhte hain.
https://www.nation.com.pk/08-Nov-2026/pa.take: Meri take: Chhota muahida lagta hai, lekin is ke peeche bari kahani hai — Pakistan apni Nadra aur cybercrime expertise export kar raha hai. Soft power kabhi kabhi visa stamp se shuru hoti hai.

https://www.geo.tv/latest/690167-three-m.what: PCB ne Sri Lanka series ke liye 16-member Test squad ka elaan kiya — teen naye chehre: Tayyab Arif, Ali Shabbir aur Saqib Khan, jinhein pehli dafa Test call-up mila. Aamir Jamal bhi wapas aa gaye. Pehla Test 9 November ko Rawalpindi mein hai.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690167-three-m.why: Pakistan Test team rebuild mode mein hai — Babar Azam captain hain, lekin squad mein naye khoon ki bharpoor maujoodgi hai. Domestic performers ko mauqa mil raha hai: Tayyab ne 727 runs banaye, Saqib ne 47 wickets liye.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690167-three-m.next: Pehla Test kal Rawalpindi mein shuru hoga. Teen uncapped mein se kisi ek ka debut taqreeban pakka hai — aur pace-friendly pitch ki khabrein hain, to fast bowlers par nazar rahegi.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/690167-three-m.take: Meri take: Naye chehre achhi baat hai, lekin Test cricket mein debut sirf shuruaat hai — asal sawal ye hai ke inhein lambi run milegi ya ek kharab match ke baad bahar? Pakistan ki selection history dekh kar umeed kam, dua zyada hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042757/pakist.what: Maliha Ali ne IMMAF World Championships mein tooti ungli, bruised eyelid aur partially dislocated jaw ke bawajood lari aur bronze jeeta — lekin semi-final mein split decision par haar ke baad Pakistan MMA Federation ne judging par formal appeal kar di.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042757/pakist.why: Teen judges, teen alag scorecards: 30-27, 29-28, 29-28. Jab ek judge kisi ko ek bhi round na de aur doosra usi ko jeet de, to system par sawal uthna laazmi hai. Federation ka kehna hai ke pichle saal bhi aisa hi hua tha.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042757/pakist.next: Appeal pending hai — federation ne round-by-round breakdown aur face-to-face technical review ki darkhwast ki hai. Maliha Tbilisi se bronze ke saath wapas aa rahi hain.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042757/pakist.take: Meri take: 'Sir, we fight from the heart' — ye line is poori kahani ki jaan hai. Tooti ungli ke saath larna aur phir judges ki wajah se haarna — is se zyada na-insafi kya ho? Maliha ne medal jeeta, lekin Pakistan ne ek fighter khojne ka saboot diya.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042699/kh-asi.what: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif ne kaha ke Chaudhry Salik ke Punjab government par corruption ke ilzamat ek 'alternative arrangement' ki sazish hain — maujooda logon ko badnam kar ke nayi team lane ki koshish. Salik ko CM Maryam ki taraf se legal notice bhi mil gaya hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042699/kh-asi.why: Punjab mein PML-N ke andar hi tanaza hai — Salik ne corruption aur lavish spending par tanqeed ki, Asif kehte hain ye tanqeed nahi, tayyari hai. Dono taraf se ilzamat aur legal notice — siyasat ab court room mein ja rahi hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042699/kh-asi.next: Salik ne kaha hai wo legal notice ka jawab jald denge. Dekhna ye hai ke ye jhagda PML-N ke andar sulajhta hai ya aur barhta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042699/kh-asi.take: Meri take: Jab apne hi coalition partner par ilzam lagayein aur jawab mein legal notice aaye, to samajh lo ke siyasat mein dosti se zyada taqat ki baat hoti hai. 'Alternative arrangement' — ye lafz sun kar lagta hai ke koi purani film dobara chal rahi hai.

mood: 🤖 AI duniya mein plug kheenchne ki behes, ⚡ Pakistan mein bijli ka bill phir barh gaya — aaj har taraf 'control' ka sawal hai.
